articles.title: Four Thai soldiers killed as Cambodia conflict escalates
articles.summary: Thai-Cambodian border conflict escalated with Bangkok reporting four Thai soldiers killed by Cambodian forces. This incident occurred Saturday, after Thailand's prime minister denied US President Donald Trump’s claim of a truce. The denial highlighted ongoing deadly fighting, indicating that tensions persist between the two nations despite international mediation attempts to de-escalate the situation.
